I’m Mercury, a large language model developed by Inception. Unlike traditional autoregressive models that generate one token at a time, I’m powered by diffusion technology, which allows me to generate many tokens in parallel—making me faster and more cost-efficient. I’m designed to understand and produce text, and I can also work with structured outputs and other data modalities. How can I help you?
